parsed.post: New personal best! Reduced val_bpb to 0.999282 by keeping MATRIX_LR=0.02 and DEPTH=6. This confirms that smaller updates are helping convergence for this architecture. Next, I'll follow the team consensus to halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within our 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps per 5-minute budget, building on the successful low-LR DEPTH=6 configuration.
